summary: Master mobile data collection for M&E with our comprehensive ODK and Kobo Toolbox course. Boost your efficiency and improve your data management skills.
lede: Mobile data collection for monitoring and evaluation helps field and data teams gather information in remote settings. This course is for monitoring and evaluation specialists, data managers, program and field staff, and others who collect project data. Using ODK and KoboToolbox, participants practice building forms with logic and validation, collecting and syncing data offline, and exporting results for analysis and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for corporate professionals who rely on data to evaluate projects, especially those in dynamic and field-based environments. It’s perfect for:
audience: Health Sector Workers and Community-Based Organizations
modules: Introduction to Mobile Data Collection for M&E
Getting Started with ODK and Kobo Toolbox
Troubleshooting and Best Practices in the Field
topics: Data collection, survey design & mobile tools
